thread.title: Apple Inc. (AAPL): Analyst Ratings You Should Pay Attention To

author: Tanaya Tak
title: Apple Inc. (AAPL): Analyst Ratings You Should Pay Attention To
text:
February 6, 2019 Share
Analysts at UBS lifted target price for shares of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) but repeated their Buy recommendation for the stock in their opinion released on January 30. The price target has been raised from $180 to $185. Rosenblatt analysts again handed out a Neutral rating to AAPL stock but they lifted target price for the shares in a flash note to investors on January 30. The price target has been raised from $165 to $150. Rosenblatt, analysts launched coverage of AAPL stock with a Neutral rating, according to their flash note to investors on January 30. Analysts at Morgan Stanley are sticking to their Overweight recommendation. However, on January 30, they lifted target price for these shares to $197 from $211. Analysts at Morgan Stanley, made their first call for the stock with a Overweight rating, according to a research note that dated back to January 30.
Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) short sellers believe it will decline in price. The most recent short interest data has been released for the January 15th settlement date, which shows a 1,300,015 share increase in total short interest for AAPL, to 46,579,709, a surge of 2.87% since December 31st. Average daily volume for Apple Inc. at the January 15th settlement plunged to 45,191,034, as compared to 51,387,635 at the December 31st report. That brought days to cover to 1.030729, a 3.07% increase from the 1 days to cover recorded at the prior short interest data release. You could look at analyst ratings. The average analyst recommendations at 2.2 suggests buying these shares. But the opinions of a small number of people, though sometimes influential, doesn’t always speak for the hundreds of thousands of traders on Wall Street.
 Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)’s prospects. The earliest insider trade took place on 02/01/2019. Levinson Arthur D parted with a total of 1.52 thousand shares of company at average share price of $167.71. The total for the sales was set at $255.09 thousand. After this transaction, the Director account balance stood at 1.15 million shares. The stock grew 3.86 percent since that insider sale. On 11/19/2018, Kondo Chris, Principal Accounting Officer, sold 3.41 thousand shares at a price per share of $190. This removed 647.52 thousand shares from the insider’s fortune and the stock saw a -8.33 percent retreat in value since the news became public. This transaction left 8.94 thousand shares in the Principal Accounting Officer account. On 10/05/2018, Senior Vice President Ahrendts Angela J performed a sale transaction worth $14.82 million. This sale at $230.89 each has eliminated 64.19 thousand shares from the insider’s portfolio position. Meanwhile, shares have recorded -24.56 percent decrease since the transaction was reported. The insider now is left with 66.34 thousand shares remaining in the account. Maestri Luca, who performs the Senior Vice President, CFO job, sold 100.25 thousand shares for $22.91 million. The disposal occurred on 10/04/2018 was priced at $228.56 per share. The share price plunged -23.79 percent since the reporting date. Maestri Luca now left with a stake of 27.32 thousand AAPL stock worth $4.76 million after the insider selling.
Apple Inc. (AAPL) is expected to jump by 2.6 percent over the next 12 months, according to price target estimates compiled by finviz. Meanwhile, they have set a $245 price as 12-month high target. This represents a whopping 40.66 percent increase from where shares are trading today. The 12-month median price target assigned by the analysts stands at $180, which represents a return potential of 3.34 percent when compared to the closing price of the stock of $174.18 on Tuesday, February 05. The lowest price target for the stock is $140 — slightly more than -19.62 percent from AAPL’s current share price.
The shares are currently floating around the first support level of $172.66. Below this, the next support is placed in the zone of $171.14. Till the time, the AAPL 66.62 on daily chart, which may remain a cause for concern. If the price breaks below $171.14 $175.39 mark may result into a pull-back move towards $176.6 level.
AAPL shares accumulated 2.93 points or 1.71 percent on Tuesday to $174.18 with a light trade volume of 36.009 million shares. After opening the session at $172.86, the shares went as high as $175.08 and as low as $172.3501, $836 billion and now has 4.8 billion shares outstanding. Apple Inc. (AAPL) stock has gained 17.48 percent of market value in 21 trading days.
AAPL stock has a trailing 3-year beta of 1.08, offering the possibility of a higher rate of return, but also posing more $12.15 a share in the trailing twelve months. The stock’s value has surged 10.42 percent year to date (YTD) against a rise of 8.52 percent in 12 month’s time. The company’s shares still trade -25.4 percent away from its 1-year high of $233.47 and 22.66 percent up from 52-week low of $142.00. The average consensus rating on the company is 2.2, sell.
Shares of Apple Inc. (AAPL) are trading at a P/E ratio of 14.34 times earnings reported for the past 12 months. The industry AAPL operates in has an average P/E of 6.17. Its P/E ratio went as low as 12.45X and as high as 18.49 over the 5-year span. Further, it is sporting a 3.15 on the Price-to-Sales ratio. Compare this with the industry average P/S of 1.23. 38.3 percent is the gross profit margin for Apple Inc. and operating margin sits at 26.7 percent. Along with this, the net profit margin is 22.4 percent.
AAPL will be showing off its Q2 earnings on April 30. Analysts are forecasting revenue to suffer decline of -4.9 percent to $84B in the next fiscal quarter, while earnings are seen soaring by nearly 7.2 percent to $4.17 per share. History has shown that shares in Apple Inc. have gone up on 19 different earnings reaction days and are predicted to add 0.04 percent when the company reports upcoming earnings. In last reported earnings results, it earned $2.91 per share, better than the $2.78, adjusted, expected by Thomson Reuters consensus estimate. Revenue was $62.9B, better than the $61.6B analysts expected. Earnings are estimated to increase by 32.6 percent this year, 11.54 percent next year and continue to increase by 13 percent annually for the next 5 years. TAGS
